archetypes.name: dyn-process-ownership
archetypes.rationale: Validate daemon-owned liveness and fork-safe locking across reattach and expiry.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the bgjob adapter's daemon-versus-child ownership decisions. Focus on whether live, dead, expired, and identity-unverifiable registry states can ever duplicate work, emit an unvalidated PGID, or strand result publication. Check the fork-close behavior and serialized decision boundary. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
